Save an interactive network graph to HTML or PNG

Source: R/network_widget.R
saveNetwork.Rd

Writes a widget produced by forceGraph — including the enrichment maps and subnetworks returned by viewEnrichMap and viewSubNet — to a file. This is the programmatic counterpart of the "Export as png" button in the interactive report, so the figures can be produced from a script without opening a browser by hand.

Usage

saveNetwork(widget, file, width = 1000, height = 750, delay = 2, ...)

Arguments

widget

an object returned by forceGraph, typically the value of viewEnrichMap() or viewSubNet().

file

output file name; must end in .html or .png.

width, height

output size in pixels.

delay

seconds to wait before the screenshot, giving the force layout time to settle. Defaults to 2 seconds.

...

further arguments passed to webshot.

Value

The output path, invisibly.

Details

The format is chosen from the file extension. HTML output is self-contained and keeps the graph interactive. PNG output is rendered headlessly through webshot2 and therefore also needs that package plus a Chrome-based browser; interactive controls are omitted from the PNG so the result is suitable for a manuscript or slide.

See also

forceGraph

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(d7_gsca)
map <- viewEnrichMap(d7_gsca, gscs = "GO_MF", gsNameType = "term")
saveNetwork(map, "enrichment-map.html")
saveNetwork(map, "enrichment-map.png", width = 1200, height = 900)
} # }
